homeVideos.title: First Night in the New House
homeVideos.description: Nina and Daniel eat takeout on the Bellwick kitchen floor while unpacked boxes make finding the plates impossible.

homeVideos.title: Christmas Tree 2013
homeVideos.description: Daniel steadies the tree in Bellwick as Nina finds the handmade star from their first apartment.

homeVideos.title: Welcome Home, Maya
homeVideos.description: Baby Maya arrives home in Bellwick while Grandma June negotiates with the family dog for a quiet welcome.

homeVideos.title: Claire and Ben’s Wedding
homeVideos.description: At the Portmere harbor hall, Aunt Claire and Ben exchange vows as Maya sleeps through the applause.

homeVideos.title: Maya’s First Steps
homeVideos.description: Maya takes four careful steps across the Bellwick living room toward Daniel's outstretched hands.

homeVideos.title: Maya’s First Birthday
homeVideos.description: Nina brings out a strawberry cake in Bellwick while Maya studies the candle more closely than her guests.

homeVideos.title: Beach Day at Sandbar Cove
homeVideos.description: Maya fills a bucket with shells at Sandbar Cove before the incoming tide reaches her sandcastle.

homeVideos.title: Christmas Morning 2016
homeVideos.description: In the Bellwick living room, Maya gives Grandma June a drawing before anyone opens a wrapped present.

homeVideos.title: Leo’s First Day Home
homeVideos.description: Nina carries baby Leo through the front door while Maya introduces him to every stuffed animal on her bed.

homeVideos.title: Maya’s First Recital
homeVideos.description: At Bellwick Arts Hall, Maya pauses halfway through her piano piece, finds Nina in the audience, and begins again.

homeVideos.title: Road Trip to Orin Lake
homeVideos.description: Daniel records the winding drive to Orin Lake while Maya counts bridges and Leo refuses to nap.

homeVideos.title: Christmas Cookie Afternoon
homeVideos.description: Grandma June lets Maya and Leo press uneven stars into dough before the first tray goes in.

homeVideos.title: Maya’s 5th Birthday
homeVideos.description: Maya races her friends through a backyard treasure hunt in Bellwick before the rain reaches the cake table.

homeVideos.title: Saturday Soccer 2019
homeVideos.description: At the Bellwick field, Maya scores her first goal and runs to the wrong sideline to celebrate.

homeVideos.title: Backyard Campout
homeVideos.description: Nina pitches a tent behind the house while Leo insists their flashlight signals can reach the moon.

homeVideos.title: First Snowball Fight
homeVideos.description: After the season's first snowfall, Daniel teaches Maya and Leo to build a snow fort before dinner.

homeVideos.title: Leo’s First Bike Ride
homeVideos.description: Leo pedals the length of Cedar Lane without help while Maya runs beside him calling out every driveway.

homeVideos.title: Back to School 2021
homeVideos.description: Nina films Maya and Leo at the Bellwick school gates as Leo carefully rehearses his teacher's name.

homeVideos.title: Lisbon Tram Day
homeVideos.description: On a steep Lisbon street, Maya and Leo watch trams climb past their lunch table before finding the overlook.

homeVideos.title: The Swimming Badge
homeVideos.description: At Bellwick Pool, Maya swims one full lap while Leo cheers louder than the instructor's whistle.

homeVideos.title: Iceland Ring Road, Day Four
homeVideos.description: Near Iceland's south coast, Daniel films Maya reading the map while Leo counts waterfalls from the back seat.

homeVideos.title: Leo’s Winter Recital
homeVideos.description: Leo plays his first violin duet at Bellwick Arts Hall and bows a beat before his partner.

homeVideos.title: Grandma June’s 80th
homeVideos.description: Three generations surprise Grandma June at the Bellwick garden hall with photographs from every decade.

homeVideos.title: Cedar Ridge Hike
homeVideos.description: At Cedar Ridge, Maya leads the family up the overlook trail while Leo carries the binoculars.

homeVideos.title: Beach Week Sandcastle
homeVideos.description: At Sandbar Cove, Maya and Leo build a sprawling sandcastle that survives until the evening tide.

homeVideos.title: Emma and Noah’s Wedding
homeVideos.description: Cousins Emma and Noah dance under string lights in Rosemont while Grandma June claims the first slice of cake.

homeVideos.title: New Year’s Pancakes
homeVideos.description: On New Year's morning, Leo flips his first pancake in Bellwick and catches it on the second try.

homeVideos.title: Maya’s School Play
homeVideos.description: Maya delivers her first solo line on the Bellwick school stage after helping a nervous classmate find her place.

homeVideos.title: Spring Soccer Final
homeVideos.description: At the Bellwick final, Maya sets up the winning goal and Leo waves a homemade banner from the sideline.

homeVideos.title: Last Day of School 2026
homeVideos.description: Outside Bellwick Middle School, Maya and Leo compare yearbooks while Nina waits with ice cream.
